methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was fetched directly and cross-checked against independent aggregators (Capterra, G2) and vendor help centers. Verified 2026-06-18. IMPORTANT CORRECTIONS to the draft methodology: (1) Optmyzr's pricing page does NOT display fixed $299/$389 text prices — it uses an ad-spend slider and routes to sales; the $299 (Essentials) / $389 (Premium) starting figures are corroborated by Capterra (capterra.com/p/156308/Optmyzr/pricing) and G2, so they are retained as published starting prices but provenance has been corrected to reflect that they are corroborated, not directly scraped. (2) Adalysis's pricing page likewise renders an interactive slider, not fixed text tiers; the six tier prices ($126/$211/$296/$381/$509/$658) match the current Capterra listing exactly and are retained on that basis, but some 2026 aggregator summaries report a higher $149 entry tier — flagged as medium confidence. Adalysis entry-plan free trial is 30 days (confirmed twice on the live page), not 14. (3) Adpulse is the confirmed rebrand of PPC Samurai (ppcsamurai.com 301-redirects to adpulse.app/blog/news/ppc-samurai-has-evolved-into-adpulse). Adpulse is currently running a $19.99 first-month June promotion (a trial-then-rebill teaser); the recurring tier prices in this dataset are the true post-promo rates, NOT the $19.99 teaser. (4) Shape.io correctly excluded (acquired by NinjaCat 2022). (5) Adsmurai publishes tier structure but no USD prices — all monthlyUsd recorded as null. No vendors were fabricated and none were removed. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Optmyzr
vendors.provenance: Starting prices ($299 Essentials, $389 Premium) corroborated via Capterra (capterra.com/p/156308/Optmyzr/pricing) and G2; the live optmyzr.com/pricing page itself does NOT show fixed text prices but an ad-spend slider routing to sales. Spend limits, overage structure, and 30-day money-back guarantee confirmed on the Optmyzr Help Center billing FAQ. Annual billing saves 30%. 14-day free trial (no card).

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Starts at $299/month (monthly billing) or ~$209/month (annual billing, 30% discount). Covers monthly ad spend up to $150K. Includes AI insights, Rule Engine automation, cross-platform dashboards, Google/Microsoft/Amazon/Meta/LinkedIn Ads. Tiered overage charges apply per additional $1K of spend above the base tier. 14-day free trial, no credit card. 30-day money-back guarantee on first subscription. NOTE: price is a corroborated starting rate (Capterra/G2); the live pricing page uses a slider and does not display this figure as fixed text.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Starts at $389/month (monthly billing). Covers monthly ad spend up to $500K. Adds expanded automation frequencies, Shopping campaign automation, multi-account reporting, and additional support versus Essentials. Corroborated starting rate (Capterra/G2); live page is slider-based.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing for monthly ad spend exceeding $500K. Unlimited ad accounts (fair usage), dedicated account manager, custom integrations, Okta SSO, monthly training, three 1-hour onboarding sessions. Contact sales.

limits: Essentials: up to $150K monthly ad spend
